name: Income Tax e-Filing & Return (ITR)
description: Online filing of Income Tax Returns, PAN services, and tax payments by the Income Tax Department.
eligibility: Individuals/entities with taxable income or mandated filing (e.g., refund, foreign asset, high turnover).
benefits: Legal compliance, refund claims, proof of income, easier loans/visa.
application_steps: Verify via Aadhaar OTP / EVC / send ITR-V.
processing_time: Filing instant; refund within months of processing.
fees: No government filing fee; late fees under Section 234F if delayed.
validity: Annual return for each financial year.
office_locator_info: Local Income Tax offices / Aaykar Sampark Kendras.

faq.q: Which ITR form do I use?
faq.a: Depends on income source (salary, business, capital gains); portal helps select.
Yes, PAN becomes inoperative if not linked with Aadhaar (with exceptions).

ai_summary: Income Tax e-Filing lets taxpayers file ITRs, pay tax, and claim refunds online; Aadhaar-PAN linked.
ai_explanation: Taxpayers file annual returns on the e-Filing portal using the appropriate ITR form, pre-filling data where available. After paying any due tax they verify the return via Aadhaar OTP or EVC. PAN must be linked to Aadhaar. Late filing attracts Section 234F fees.
